subject: Veridian security playbook request + timelines
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@veridianbank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@veridianbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian security playbook request + timelines

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please correct me if I misstated anything.

Key pain points you raised:
- Audit log retention: regulated teams need immutable audit logs retained for 7 years and tamper-evidence for key actions.
- SOC 2 & attestation: Veridian requires a current SOC 2 Type II report (or equivalent) and a plan for quarterly control testing.
- DPA / Data residency: DPA terms must include specific subprocessing notices and deletion timelines for customer data on contract termination.
- Pen test & vulnerability evidence: You need a copy of most recent pen test report plus remediation evidence or the remediation timeline for open findings.
- Access controls: MFA enforcement, role-based access, and admin audit trails for the control plane.

What we committed to on the call:
1) Share a condensed SOC 2 summary deck + list of artifacts we can provide (asset roster, control owners, testing windows) — delivery by Tue 2/23. (attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
2) Provide an audit log retention matrix showing retention periods, retention tiers (hot/cold), and backup immutability details — delivery by Wed 2/24. (attachment: redwood-audit-log-retention-matrix.xlsx)
3) Send a draft DPA with the specific clauses you asked for (subprocessors, deletion, breach notification SLAs) — first pass by Fri 2/26. (attachment: dpa-draft-veridian.docx)
4) Share the most recent independent penetration test scope and redacted findings + remediation artifacts or remediation plan for any open items — by Fri 2/26. (attachment: pen-test-scope.txt)
5) Set up a 30-minute follow-up to walk the security team through artifacts and answer technical verification questions — proposed slot: Wed 2/24 10:00–10:30 PT.

Open questions for you to confirm (so we can prioritize):
- Do you require original pen-test vendor contact info for verification, or is a redacted vendor + signed attestation sufficient?
- For retention: is a 7-year immutable retention for audit logs mandatory for the initial acceptance, or can we provide a transitional acceptance plan for year 1–2 while longer-term immutability is being implemented?
- Any additional compliance frameworks beyond SOC 2 (e.g., GLBA-specific controls) we should map now?

Next steps from our side: Aditya will own the SOC2 artifact pull, I’ll own the retention matrix and DPA draft, and Karthik will coordinate the pen-test artifact collation and reach out to our pen-test vendor.

Thanks again — we want to make this as painless as possible. If the 2/24 slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short slide pack attached.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

(attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@veridianbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@veridianbank.com>, security@veridianbank.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian security playbook request + timelines

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Pen-test vendor info: we prefer a vendor contact + redacted report; if that’s not possible we’ll accept a vendor-signed attestation plus the redacted findings.
- Retention: 7 years immutable is the standard we’re trying to hold to for audit logs for covered systems. If you can provide a transitional plan that commits to 7 years by a fixed milestone (e.g., within 12 months), that may be acceptable with our audit team — but we’ll need the interim safeguards documented.
- SOC2: we need the most recent Type II report; a Type I plus a roadmap is not sufficient for production access.

We’re okay with the 2/24 10:00 PT slot — I see a calendar invite pending.

Action for Redwood: please include an index of artifacts you’ll send and call out any items that may be redacted for vendor confidentiality.

Tom
VP, Risk & Compliance
Veridian Bank
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@veridianbank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@veridianbank.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian security playbook request + timelines

Looping in internal owners and some notes from our side.

Soojin / Aditya —
- I’ll pull the pen-test artifacts and confirm what can be shared verbatim vs redacted. Vendor point of contact is RedOak Security (will reach out and ask for an attestation + redacted PDF).
- Aditya — please confirm the latest SOC 2 Type II report date and the primary control owners we should surface on the call.
- I’ll draft a short acceptance checklist for Veridian (SOC2 date, pen-test attestation, retention matrix, DPA signature) so Tom/ Elaine can use it to sign off once artifacts are verified.

Proposed deliverable deadlines (internal):
- Soc2 summary + index: EOD Tue 2/23 (Aditya)
- Retention matrix: EOD Wed 2/24 (Soojin)
- DPA first draft: Fri 2/26 (Soojin)
- Pen-test attestation & redacted report: Fri 2/26 (Karthik)

I’ll also prepare a short slide (1–2 slides) showing how our immutable retention works (WORM on cold storage + signed manifests) so we can demonstrate immutability guarantees.

-Karthik
Director, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Veridian security playbook request + timelines — artifacts and invite

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks — we’ve captured the items below and are starting artifact collection. I’ve attached the SOC 2 summary and the retention matrix draft for your review (these are initial drafts; we’ll finalize after the 2/24 sync).

Deliverables we will upload to the shared Drive by EOD Mon 2/22:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (condensed SOC2 Type II highlights + index of available artifacts)
- redwood-audit-log-retention-matrix.xlsx (retention tiers, immutability controls, restore windows)

To be delivered by Fri 2/26:
- dpa-draft-veridian.docx (DPA draft reflecting subprocessor list and deletion timelines)
- pen-test-scope.txt + redacted report or vendor attestation (RedOak Security)

Follow-up call: confirmed Wed 2/24 10:00–10:30 PT (invite sent). Please add any additional attendees from your security or legal teams.

If you need anything earlier (e.g., a short attestation letter only), let me know and we’ll prioritize.

Best regards,

--
